The '''Pillar of the Ancestors''' was a massive stone pillar located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Quolas]]. The Pillar was hundreds of [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and was carved with images from Quolas' history. Eventually,
the tyrant [[Gel Marcolf]] began to replace the Pillar's carvings with images of his own "great deeds."
